# DeepSeek V4 知识结构图谱

## 图 1：发布时机与竞争关系

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    GPT_New_Version["GPT 新版本发布"]:::event
    DeepSeek_V4_Release["DeepSeek V4 发布"]:::event
    Timing_Advantage["时间点巧合优势"]:::note

    GPT_New_Version -->|紧随其后| DeepSeek_V4_Release
    DeepSeek_V4_Release --> Timing_Advantage
    GPT_New_Version --> Timing_Advantage

    classDef event fill:#e0f7fa,stroke:#006064;
    classDef note fill:#fff3e0,stroke:#bf360c;
```

    subgraph Model_Comparison["模型对比"]
        DeepSeek_V4["DeepSeek V4"]

    DeepSeek_V4 -->|在多数列前列| col2

    GBT5_4 -->|部分列竞争| col2
    Germany3_1 -->|部分列竞争| col1

    classDef col fill:#f1f8e9,stroke:#33691e;
    classDef Model_Comparison fill:#e8eaf6,stroke:#1a237e;
